candidateLedger.title: Check-time label had an overbroad model-loading exclusion

evidenceHistory.evidence: The original label said excludes model loading. RecipeService starts its clock before DecisionModel.context and context.decide; context creation and reusable-runtime preparation may load internal runtime assets. Explicit loadModel and Service queueing are excluded.

Current Inspector says excludes opening the selected bundle and queueing. docs/recipes-demo.md explicitly states internal runtime preparation during the check is included. The timer boundary and numeric implementation are unchanged.

candidateLedger.resolution: Source and user-facing explanation now agree; this was a wording ambiguity, not a measured-value defect.

candidateLedger.title: Projection could recompute a different tied winner
candidateLedger.evidence: RecipeService copies answer.top directly and maps answer.distribution without sorting, normalization or precision conversion. DecisionAnswer.choice.top returns the stored selected ID. The proposed regression test uses equal optional/required scores with stored required winner. Raw Float bit patterns survive the independent Codable probe.

candidateLedger.title: Optional diagnostic addition could reject previously saved reports
candidateLedger.evidence: diagnostics is optional without a synthesized constant default; synthesized decoding accepts absent/null. Independent Swift 6 CPU execution decoded both absent and null diagnostics with populated quantity-shortage rows. Constructor default nil preserves existing source calls.

candidateLedger.title: Question comparison could misattach an answer after order or count drift
candidateLedger.evidence: The service checks answer count and ordered ID equality before zip. Questions originate from ASCII ingredient_<Int> IDs plus equipment, so canonical-equivalent Unicode keys are not reachable here. The new mismatch test reverses answers and expects rejection.

candidateLedger.title: New details could change review, quantity or cancellation semantics
candidateLedger.evidence: The threshold is the same Float literal 0.6 and the exact prior strict comparison. FoodVocabulary.assessAll and its arguments are unchanged. Service acquire/defer release and pre/post-await cancellation checks remain unchanged; synchronous DTO construction adds no task owner or await; Runner checks cancellation before sending checked, and Feature session/revision gates remain unchanged. CPU probe independently verified both threshold boundaries, unknown amount/equipment, required egg shortage and optional notRequired.
